entries.name: ci7-stale-evidence-not-named
entries.claim: Reachability evidence from another run or an older producer definition fails check:language-coverage by name, with the producer, the evidence file and the remedy.

test.namePattern: evidence written under an older file list is stale

kills.name: evidence written under an older file list is stale, named, and says how to regenerate it

entries.name: ci7-fixture-ignores-sigterm
entries.claim: A browser fixture child that ignores SIGTERM is reported as not exited, so a teardown stall fails by name with the child output instead of a bare test timeout.

test.namePattern: a fixture that ignores SIGTERM is reported as not exited

kills.name: a fixture that ignores SIGTERM is reported as not exited and is killed
